body.name: Mass-weighted grouped moment-reconstruction handle
body.construction: Construct \(\widehat G_{\mathrm{grp}}\) by sample splitting, pilot localization of the vectors \(q_x\) into groups indexed jointly by mass shells and effect intervals, unbiased mass-weighted centered Chebyshev effect moments through degree \(K\) using joint four-cell factorial lifts, finite-grid nonnegative Hausdorff-moment programs on the effect intervals, aggregation, exact mass normalization, Rao--Blackwellization, and deterministic fallback; select the grouping, \(K\), grid, and tolerances from \(n\), \(d\), \(\epsilon\), and the exact factorial covariance.
